title: Interconnected Cyclical Loops as a Method for Constructing Artificial Subjectivity
description: The first post in a series on applying neurobiological patterns to the design of computational systems — a simple concept for building systems whose behavior looks subjective to an observer.
author: Glab Strizhkov

title: A Gigabyte for Fifty Megabytes
description: Data centers are more expensive than ever before — and it's not just about the money. How much of that rented capacity is actually doing useful work?
author: Glab Strizhkov

title: I Spent Years Being the 3 A.M. Call for Companies That Couldn’t Fix Their Own Networks
description: It’s a situation familiar to many system administrators. It’s noon, the busiest part of the workday — and everything has gone down.
author: Punkolink Team
